profile: Researcher and developer working on machine learning for architectural design. Current research applies graph neural networks and deep metric learning to correspondence between building representations at different scales, and extends to LLM agents for parametric modeling; the part-to-whole modeling method underlying this research is the subject of a pending US patent. A parallel line of work develops exact solvers for residential layout. Earlier research in Polyhedral Graphic Statics at the University of Pennsylvania produced a glass bridge exhibited at the Corning Museum of Glass.

blocks.heading: Natalie: Computational Design Platform
blocks.intro: Primary engineer across the stack: React front end, solver and ML core, Rhino and Revit integration, encrypted distribution, telemetry, and release. Funded by SOM IW, a firm subsidiary, after review by a committee of Partners; 25 production releases since 2023 (v0.5.0 to v1.3.2); in routine use on live projects across 8 offices worldwide. Proprietary to SOM; publications extract the generalizable methods.

entries.name: Facade propagation
entries.desc: Siamese heterogeneous graph attention network transferring facade systems from prototype to massing; TorchSharp inference in live Rhino sessions. 2.13M facade modules populated in one year.

entries.name: Residential planner
entries.desc: Backtracking search over a slicing-tree representation; touch adjacencies gated in search, reach adjacencies discharged by routing hallways; every rule re-verified on final geometry.

entries.name: Unit-mix planner
entries.desc: Exact MILP for unit stacking and mix across residential massings; certifies feasibility or diagnoses why none exists.

entries.name: Rhino–Revit bridge
entries.desc: Context-based porting into live Revit via Rhino.Inside: blocks arrive as placed families, planar surfaces as levels and floors — semantics survive the port.

entries.name: Graph neural networks for cross-scale building correspondence
entries.desc: Pair-local label supervision for node correspondence across graphs of different scale, without a shared label vocabulary (under review at ACADIA 2026; workshop paper in preparation).

entries.name: Deep metric learning
entries.desc: Triplet objectives with semi-hard negative mining for retrieval-based correspondence; family-clean evaluation protocols.

entries.name: Mixed-integer programming for architectural layout
entries.desc: Unit demising and stacking formulations balancing yield, code compliance, and design intent.

entries.name: Constraint-based solvers
entries.desc: Constraint algebra for room programs: proximity classes, pairing quantifiers, prohibitions; satisfaction by search where checkable, by construction where not.

blocks.heading: Research Initiatives
blocks.intro: Formal internal SOM research: three-month staffed sprints, presented to Partners and C-suite.

entries.name: Massing intelligence

entries.name: Layout representation
entries.desc: Toward a pattern algebra for exemplar transfer in residential layout.
